records.name: T1-T5.front.attempt1
records.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create production FRONT MASTERS T1 T2 T3 T4 T5 for male DAO TU Storm Reaver. Image1 is exact canonical five-direction T1; use its CENTER FRONT S male face and proportions as identity lock. Image2 older tiers is COSTUME progression reference only; do not copy its face/proportions/color. Image3 approved accent A LEFT is palette reference only. Five separate full-body FRONT S figures left-to-right T1 T2 T3 T4 T5, identical face stern grey eyes, swept black hair, low loose ponytail, same lean adult build/anatomical height, main head22% and eyes16% anatomicalH, 4.5heads. Same shoulder-carried broad mountain-ink single-edge dao and planted frontal stance. T1 exact plain T1 from image1: sleeveless muted dark teal tunic, storm grey-blue collar/sash, plain overskirt/trousers/bracers/boots, sparse mountain blade and plain dull brass guard. T2 slightly structured wrap coat, narrow aged-gold edges and small storm-blue tassel, modest blade mountain. T3 fitted dark teal sleeveless coat with storm GREY-BLUE dominant long asymmetrical skirt panels, tiny limited wind-white half mantle on left shoulder, aged-gold knot clasp and belt; grey-blue ink-wash mountains on one panel, broad dao. T4 stronger long split coat and additional storm GREY-BLUE mantle structure, restrained limited wind-white trailing cloth, weathered gold accents and refined mountain blade. T5 ornate but readable storm-grey-blue/dark teal coat, longest flowing grey-blue panels and limited wind-white streamers, old-gold fittings, refined broad ink-mountain blade; NO detached rocks/particles/glow/aura. Do not turn white/jade green like healer. Every face and visible hand SAME identity and same anatomical size. All front view exactly, not three-quarter. Entire blades and ponytails contained in each separate non-overlapping area with clear magenta gaps. Opaque flat RGB255,0,255 magenta background, no text/labels/borders/shadows. Wide five-figure model sheet, high detail clean painted premium semi-chibi xianxia, northwest light. Clothing and sword shapes evolve, not body or face.
